Content_0.en: The beauty-loving monarch longed year after year, to find a beautiful lady without peer.
Content_0.cn: 汉皇重色思倾国，御宇多年求不得。
Content_0.ru: Любящий красоту монарх год за годом мечтал найти прекрасную даму, не имеющую себе равных.

Content_1.en: A maiden of the Yangs* to womanhood just grown, in inner chambers bred, to the world was unknown.
Content_1.cn: 杨家有女初长成，养在深闺人未识。
Content_1.ru: Девушка из династии Янг* только что доросла до женственности, воспитывалась во внутренних покоях, миру была неизвестна.

Content_2.en: Endowed with natural beauty too hard to hide, one day she stood selected for the monarch's side.
Content_2.cn: 天生丽质难自弃，一朝选在君王侧。
Content_2.ru: Наделенная природной красотой, которую слишком трудно было скрыть, однажды она была выбрана на сторону монарха.

Content_3.en: Turning her head, she smiled so sweet and full of grace, that she outshone in six palaces the fairest face.
Content_3.cn: 回眸一笑百媚生，六宫粉黛无颜色。

Content_4.en: She bathed in glassy spring water of warm-fountain pool, which laved and smoothed her creamy skin when spring was cool.
Content_4.cn: 春寒赐浴华清池，温泉水滑洗凝脂。

Content_5.en: Upborne by her attendants, she rose too faint to move, and this was when she first received the monarch's love.
Content_5.cn: 侍儿扶起娇无力，始是新承恩泽时。

Content_6.en: Flowerlike face and cloudlike hair, golden-headdressed, in lotus-flower curtain she spent the night blessed.
Content_6.cn: 云鬓花颜金步摇，芙蓉帐暖度春宵。

Content_7.en: She slept till sun rose high, for the blessed night was short, from then on the monarch held no longer morning court.
Content_7.cn: 春宵苦短日高起，从此君王不早朝。

Content_8.en: In revels as in feasts she shared her lord's delight, his companion on trips and his mistress at night.
Content_8.cn: 承欢侍宴无闲暇，春从春游夜专夜。

Content_9.en: In inner palace dwelt three thousand ladies fair; on her alone was lavished royal love and care.
Content_9.cn: 后宫佳丽三千人，三千宠爱在一身。
Content_9.ru: Во внутреннем дворце обитали три тысячи прекрасных дам; на нее одну расточались королевская любовь и забота.

Content_10.en: Her beauty served the night when dressed in Golden Bower, or drunk with wine and spring at banquet in Jade Tower.
Content_10.cn: 金屋妆成娇侍夜，玉楼宴罢醉和春。

Content_11.en: All her sisters and brothers received rank and fief, and honors showered on her household,
Content_11.cn: 姊妹弟兄皆列土，可怜光彩生门户。
Content_11.ru: Все ее сестры и братья получили звания и владения, а ее домочадцев осыпали почестями,

Content_12.en: To the grief of the fathers and mothers who'd rather give birth to a fair maiden than any son on earth.
Content_12.cn: 遂令天下父母心，不重生男重生女。

Content_13.en: The lofty palace towered high into blue cloud, with wind-borne music so divine the air was loud.
Content_13.cn: 骊宫高处入青云，仙乐风飘处处闻。
Content_13.ru: Величественный дворец возвышался высоко в голубых облаках, а доносимая ветром музыка была такой божественной, что воздух был громким.

Content_14.en: Seeing slow dance and hearing fluted or stringed song, the emperor was never tired the whole day long.
Content_14.cn: 缓歌谩舞凝丝竹，尽日君王看不足。

Content_15.en: But rebels beat their war drums, making the earth quake, and "Song of Rainbow Skirt and Coat of Feathers" break.
Content_15.cn: 渔阳鼙鼓动地来，惊破霓裳羽衣曲。

Content_16.en: A cloud of dust was raised o'er city walls nine-fold; thousands of chariots and horsemen southwestward rolled.
Content_16.cn: 九重城阙烟尘生，千乘万骑西南行。

Content_17.en: Imperial flags moved slowly now and halted then, and thirty li from Western Gate they stopped again.
Content_17.cn: 翠华摇摇行复止，西出都门百余里。
Content_17.ru: Имперские флаги теперь двигались медленно, а затем остановились, и в тридцати ли от Западных ворот они снова остановились.

Content_18.en: Six armies would not march—what could be done?—with speed, until the Lady Yang was killed before the steed.
Content_18.cn: 六军不发无奈何，宛转蛾眉马前死。

Content_19.en: None would pick up her hairpin fallen to the ground, or golden bird and comb with which her head was crowned.
Content_19.cn: 花钿委地无人收，翠翘金雀玉搔头。

Content_20.en: The monarch could not save her and hid his face in fear; turning his head, he saw her blood mix with his tear.
Content_20.cn: 君王掩面救不得，回看血泪相和流。

Content_21.en: The yellow dust spread wide, the wind blew desolate; a serpentine plank path led to cloud-capped Sword Gate.
Content_21.cn: 黄埃散漫风萧索，云栈萦纡登剑阁。

Content_22.en: Below the Emei Mountains wayfarers were few; in fading sunlight royal standards lost their hue.
Content_22.cn: 峨嵋山下少人行，旌旗无光日色薄。
Content_22.ru: Ниже гор Эмэй путников было немного; в угасающем солнечном свете королевские штандарты теряли свой оттенок.

Content_23.en: On western waters blue and western mountains green, the monarch's heart was daily gnawed by sorrow keen.
Content_23.cn: 蜀江水碧蜀山青，圣主朝朝暮暮情。

Content_24.en: The moon viewed from his tent shed a soul-searing light, the bells heard in night rain made a heart-rending sound.
Content_24.cn: 行宫见月伤心色，夜雨闻铃肠断声。

Content_25.en: Suddenly turned the tide. Returning from his flight, the monarch could not tear himself away from the ground.
Content_25.cn: 天旋地转回龙驭，到此踌躇不能去。

Content_26.en: Where 'mid the clods beneath the slope he couldn't forget, the fair-faced Lady Yang, who was unfairly slain.
Content_26.cn: 马嵬坡下泥土中，不见玉颜空死处。

Content_27.en: He looked at ministers, with tears his robe was wet; they rode east to the capital, but with loose rein.
Content_27.cn: 君臣相顾尽沾衣，东望都门信马归。

Content_28.en: Back, he found her pond and garden in the old place, with lotus in the lake and willows by the hall.
Content_28.cn: 归来池苑皆依旧，太液芙蓉未央柳。
Content_28.ru: Вернувшись, он нашел ее пруд и сад на старом месте, с лотосами в озере и ивами у холла.

Content_29.en: Willow leaves like her brows and lotus like her face; at the sight of all these, how could his tears not fall?
Content_29.cn: 芙蓉如面柳如眉，对此如何不泪垂。

Content_30.en: Or when in vernal breeze were peach and plum full-blown, or when in autumn rain parasol leaves were shed?
Content_30.cn: 春风桃李花开日，秋雨梧桐叶落时。

Content_31.en: In western as in southern court was grass over grown; with fallen leaves unswept the marble steps turned red.
Content_31.cn: 西宫南内多秋草，落叶满阶红不扫。

Content_32.en: Actors, although still young, began to have hair gray; eunuchs and waiting maids looked old in palace deep.
Content_32.cn: 梨园弟子白发新，椒房阿监青娥老。

Content_33.en: Fireflies flitting the hall, mutely he pined away; the lonely lampwick burned out; still he could not sleep.
Content_33.cn: 夕殿萤飞思悄然，孤灯挑尽未成眠。

Content_34.en: Slowly beat drums and rang bells; night began to grow long; bright shone the Milky Way; daybreak seemed to come late.
Content_34.cn: 迟迟钟鼓初长夜，耿耿星河欲曙天。

Content_35.en: The lovebird tiles grew chilly with hoar frost so strong, and his kingfisher quilt was cold, not shared by a mate.
Content_35.cn: 鸳鸯瓦冷霜华重，翡翠衾寒谁与共。

Content_36.en: One long, long year the dead and the living were parted; her soul came not in dreams to see the brokenhearted.
Content_36.cn: 悠悠生死别经年，魂魄不曾来入梦。

Content_37.en: A Taoist sorcerer came to the palace door, skilled to summon the spirit from the other shore.
Content_37.cn: 临邛道士鸿都客，能以精诚致魂魄。
Content_37.ru: К дверям дворца подошел даосский колдун, умевший вызывать Духов с другого берега.

Content_38.en: Moved by the monarch's yearning for the departed fair, he was ordered to seek for her everywhere.
Content_38.cn: 为感君王辗转思，遂教方士殷勤觅。
Content_38.ru: Тронутый тоской монарха по ушедшей красавице, ему было приказано искать ее повсюду.

Content_39.en: Borne on the air, like flash of lightning he flew; in heaven and on earth he searched through and through.
Content_39.cn: 排空驭气奔如电，升天入地求之遍。

Content_40.en: Up to the azure vault and down to deepest place, nor above nor below could he e'er find her trace.
Content_40.cn: 上穷碧落下黄泉，两处茫茫皆不见。
Content_40.ru: Вверх, к лазурному своду, и вниз, в самое глубокое место, ни вверху, ни внизу он никогда не мог найти ее следа.

Content_41.en: He learned that on the sea were fairy mountains proud, that now appeared, now disappeared amid the cloud.
Content_41.cn: 忽闻海上有仙山，山在虚无缥渺间。

Content_42.en: Of rainbow colors where rose magnificent bowers, and dwelt so many fairies as graceful as flowers.
Content_42.cn: 楼阁玲珑五云起，其中绰约多仙子。
Content_42.ru: Из цветов радуги, где росли великолепные беседки и обитало так много фей, грациозных, как цветы.

Content_43.en: Among them was a queen whose name was Ever True; her snow-white skin and sweet face might afford a clue.
Content_43.cn: 中有一人字太真，雪肤花貌参差是。

Content_44.en: Knocking at the west wing of the palace hall, he bade the porter fair to inform the queen's waiting maid.
Content_44.cn: 金阙西厢叩玉扃，转教小玉报双成。

Content_45.en: When she heard there came the monarch's embassy, the queen was startled out of dreams in her canopy.
Content_45.cn: 闻道汉家天子使，九华帐里梦魂惊。
Content_45.ru: Услышав, что прибыло посольство монарха, королева очнулась от грез под своим балдахином.

Content_46.en: Pushing aside the pillow, she rose and got dressed, passing through silver screen and pearl shade to meet the guest.
Content_46.cn: 揽衣推枕起徘徊，珠箔银屏迤逦开。

Content_47.en: Her cloudlike hair awry, not full awake at all, her flowery cap slanted, she came into the hall.
Content_47.cn: 云鬓半偏新睡觉，花冠不整下堂来。
Content_47.ru: С растрепанными, как облако, волосами, совсем не проснувшаяся, в цветастой шапочке, сдвинутой набок, она вошла в холл.

Content_48.en: The wind blew up her fairy sleeves and made them float as if she danced the "Rainbow Skirt and Feathered Coat."
Content_48.cn: 风吹仙袂飘飘举，犹似霓裳羽衣舞。

Content_49.en: Her jade-white face crisscrossed with tears in lonely world, like a spray of pear blossoms in spring rain impearled.
Content_49.cn: 玉容寂寞泪阑干，梨花一枝春带雨。

Content_50.en: She bade him thank her lord, lovesick and brokenhearted; they knew nothing of each other after they parted.
Content_50.cn: 含情凝睇谢君王，一别音容两渺茫。

Content_51.en: Love and happiness long ended within palace walls; days and months appeared long in the fairyland halls.
Content_51.cn: 昭阳殿里恩爱绝，蓬莱宫中日月长。

Content_52.en: Turning her head and fixing on the earth her gaze, she saw no capital 'mid clouds of dust and haze.
Content_52.cn: 回头下望人寰处，不见长安见尘雾。
Content_52.ru: Повернув голову и устремив взгляд на землю, она не увидела столицы среди облаков пыли и тумана.

Content_53.en: To show her love was deep, she took out keepsakes old for him to carry back, hairpin and case of gold.
Content_53.cn: 惟将旧物表深情，钿合金钗寄将去。

Content_54.en: Keeping one side of the case and one wing of the pin, she sent to her dear lord the other half of the twin.
Content_54.cn: 钗留一股合一扇，钗擘黄金合分钿。

Content_55.en: "If our two hearts are as firm as the gold should remain. In heaven or on earth we'll sometime meet again."
Content_55.cn: 但教心似金钿坚，天上人间会相见。

Content_56.en: At parting she confided to the messenger a secret vow known only to her lord and her.
Content_56.cn: 临别殷勤重寄词，词中有誓两心知。
Content_56.ru: На прощание она доверила посланнику тайную клятву, известную только ее господину и ей самой.

Content_57.en: On seventh day of seventh moon when none was near, at midnight in Long Life Hall he whispered in her ear,
Content_57.cn: 七月七日长生殿，夜半无人私语时。

Content_58.en: "On high, we'd be two lovebirds flying wing to wing; on earth, two trees with branches twined from spring to spring."
Content_58.cn: 在天愿作比翼鸟，在地愿为连理枝。

Content_59.en: The boundless sky and endless earth may pass away, but this vow unfulfilled will be regretted for aye.
Content_59.cn: 天长地久有时尽，此恨绵绵无绝期。

Content_60.en: From lowest to highest; Tier 9: <color=#8E8E8EFF>Gray</color>\nTier 8: <color=#FBFBFBFF>Pearl</color>; Tier 7: <color=#6DB75FFF>Green</color>; Tier 6: <color=#8FBAE7FF>Blue</color>; Tier 5: <color=#63CED0FF>Cyan</color>; Tier 4: <color=#AE5AC8FF>Violet</color>; Tier 3: <color=#E3C66DFF>Gold</color>; Tier 2: <color=#F28234FF>Orange</color>\nTier 1: <color=#E4504DFF>Red</color>.
Content_60.cn: 至低九品<color=#8E8E8EFF>灰</color>、\n八品<color=#FBFBFBFF>白</color>、七品<color=#6DB75FFF>绿</color>、六品<color=#8FBAE7FF>蓝</color>、五品<color=#63CED0FF>青</color>、四品<color=#AE5AC8FF>紫</color>、三品<color=#E3C66DFF>金</color>、二品<color=#F28234FF>橙</color>、\n至高一品<color=#E4504DFF>赤</color>。

Content_61.cn:
鸣不失时，信也；
遇敌必斗，勇也；
伤重不降，忠也；
败则不鸣，知耻辱也；
寒则归宁，识时务也。

Content_62.en:
Pure Essence is the result of accumulation across generations.
It cannot be achieved overnight. Only through inheritance and progress over generations can it be attained.
Only by generations of dedication to martial study can one finally reach the ultimate martial arts, the highest level.
However, thanks to the Fuyu Hilt, Taiwu's Pure Essence may be enhanced by reclaiming the power of other divine swords...
Content_62.cn:
所谓精纯，乃世代累积之功也——
精纯境界无法一蹴而就，非代代相传、日积月累不能达成！
唯有通过世世代代对武学的钻研，方能最终臻至武学之极意、精纯之最高化境。
然而得益于伏虞剑柄，太吾之精纯却可依靠收回其它神剑之力而获得增进……

Content_63.en: Crickets are nimble creatures and extremely difficult to catch.\nOnly when they are singing in complete abandon, at their most intense, should one make a move. Then success is all but guaranteed.
Content_63.cn: 促织乃机敏之物，极难捕获。\n唯有在其鸣叫至最忘情，最激烈之时再出手捕捉，方可十拿九稳。

Content_64.en: Frequent re-entry into the same time point (S/L) in the world of Taiwu may leave you exhausted and your Qi scattered...
Content_64.cn: 过于频繁地反复出入太吾世界的某一时间点（S/L），将有可能导致你神疲力乏，精元溃散……

Content_65.en: In populated areas, residents may contract the incurable disease, "Blackstone Ash".\nOnly by harnessing the power of will within the Fuyu Hilt can the Blackstone Ash Erosion be suppressed...
Content_65.cn: 人口繁密之地，其中居民便可能感染名为“玄石火灰”的不治之症。\n以伏虞剑柄中蕴藏的心念之力，方能抑制玄灰侵蚀……

Content_66.en: Blackstone ruins resulted by Xiangshu's corruption!\nBarrenness reigns upon the Blackstone Land, and countless Xiangshu Underlings roam within. To traverse the Land is to court near-certain death!
Content_66.cn: 因相枢之乱而化为遍地玄石的废墟！\n玄石之地寸草不生，更有无数相枢爪牙徘徊其中，于玄石之地穿行，实乃九死一生！

Content_67.en: You can only invite Taiwu villagers or close ones to be your Companions.\nHowever, everyone has their own aspirations. Even your parents or children may refuse your request...
Content_67.cn: 你只能邀请太吾村民，或交情甚笃之人成为同道。\n但是，人各有志，即使是你的父母、子女，亦有可能拒绝你的请求……

Content_68.en: The vast lands inspire many to roam far and wide, who often equip themselves with vehicles to save time and effort...
Content_68.cn: 神州大地幅员辽阔，喜欢游历四方的人，往往会为自己配备省时省力的代步工具……

Content_69.en: As the seasons turn, characters' abilities gradually recover...
Content_69.cn: 时节流转，人物的能力也会随之恢复……
Content_69.ru: По мере смены сезонов способности персонажей постепенно восстанавливаются...

Content_70.en: Fine wine and delicacies each have their effects, but moderation is key. Once full and bloated, one must wait for digestion before eating again...
Content_70.cn: 美酒佳肴各有功效，然而饮食亦有度，若是酒足饭饱，腹中鼓胀，便需待消化之后方可进食……

Content_71.en: Within each season are three months. The final month belongs to Earth, while the others align as follows: Spring with Wood, Summer with Fire, Autumn with Metal, and Winter with Water.\nThis is known as "Spring Wood, Summer Fire, Autumn Metal, Winter Water, and Seasonal Earth"...
Content_71.cn: 一季之中，分为三月，以其末月属土，其余诸月，春属木，夏属火，秋属金，冬属水。\n所谓“春木、夏火、秋金、冬水、季土”是也……

Content_72.en: As the saying goes, "Balance study and action". Beyond diligent study, traveling the land and sparring with others may also bring insights into one's learning...
Content_72.cn: 所谓“文武之道，一张一弛”，平日埋头苦读之余，游历四方、与他人切磋较量，也有机会领悟所学……

Content_73.en: Among the mind methods in martial arts, some follow orthodox paths, while others blaze their own trails.\nEven the same technique may manifest different effects depending on the practitioner's understanding...
Content_73.cn: 世间武学之心法，有循规蹈矩者，亦有另辟蹊径者。\n即便是同一门功法，也可能会因修习者领悟心法的不同，而显现出不同的效果……

Content_74.en: Different Martial Arts possess different bottleneck weaknesses.\nThus, those who deviate during breakthroughs may sustain different types of damage...
Content_74.cn: 不同的功法，因其玄关弱点的不同，\n往往也会使突破中走火入魔的修习者受到不同性质的伤害……

Content_75.en: The bottlenecks of Martial Arts are not easily perceived without great talent or resolve.\nThose lacking aptitude who force a breakthrough may inevitably harm themselves...
Content_75.cn: 功法玄关，非天资聪颖，或有大毅力者不能窥破，\n若资质不足者强行为之，则难免伤及自身……

Content_76.en: As the saying goes, only when you need it do you regret not having read enough. Some books that seem useless may yet aid advancement during study...
Content_76.cn: 所谓书到用时方恨少，一些看似无用的书籍，或许也会成为研读精进时的助力……

Content_77.en: Studying books is dull.\nBut at times, flashes of inspiration may arise, hastening one's progress...
Content_77.cn: 研读书籍的过程平淡且乏味，\n但偶尔，人们也会有灵光一现的各种想法，能够加快研读的进展……
Content_77.ru: Изучать книги скучно.\Но время от времени могут возникать вспышки вдохновения, ускоряющие чей-то прогресс...

Content_78.en: Names often carry beautiful hopes, yet some willingly abandon their birth names to mark their separation from the mundane...
Content_78.cn: 姓名之中，往往寄寓着许多美好的期望，但也有自愿放弃了本名，以示与俗有别的人……

Content_79.en: Taiwu villagers are unfailingly loyal to Taiwu. Even from afar, they will heed Taiwu's commands...
Content_79.cn: 太吾村民对太吾莫不忠心耿耿，即便远在千里之外，也会听从太吾的号令……
Content_79.ru: Жители деревни Тайу неизменно преданы Тайу. Даже издалека они будут прислушиваться к командам Тайу...

Content_80.en: When assigning villagers to work, grant the overseer a fitting rank will earn obedience and unite efforts...
Content_80.cn: 安排村民劳作时，若是能够授予主事者相称的身份，便能使众人服膺，齐心协力……

Content_81.en: Though villagers willingly aid Taiwu in eradicating Xiangshu,\nwithout proper housing in the village, their morale will inevitably suffer...
Content_81.cn: 太吾村的村民虽自愿成为太吾消灭相枢的助力，\n但若是在村中没有居住的场所，也会不可避免地心情低落……

Content_82.en: The Gongshu's Caravan excels in construction. Certain special materials required for buildings may be found among its merchants and caravans...
Content_82.cn: 公输坊擅长营造建设，一些建筑所用的特殊心材，往往能在其名下的商人、商队中找到……

Content_83.en: Sharing tales of distant lands with others may inspire their longing for those cultures...
Content_83.cn: 若对一个人讲述某地的见闻，可能会使他们对该地的文化产生向往……
Content_83.ru: Рассказывая другим истории о далеких странах, вы можете пробудить в них тягу к этим культурам...

Content_84.en: To obtain quality goods at fair prices, observe merchants' dispositions and befriend the amiable ones...
Content_84.cn: 若想买到物美价廉的商品，不妨关注一下各个商人的处世之道，择其和善者缔结良谊……

Content_85.en: When roaming the martial world, don't forget the Xiangshu Incarnation within the Sword Mound, lest Taiwu Inheritance come to an end...
Content_85.cn: 在江湖中行走时，切莫忘记剑冢里的相枢化身，以免太吾传承就此断绝……

Content_86.en: True Qi is condensed from internal Qi and flows through the body's meridians.\nA martial grandmaster who disperses all their True Qi is scarcely different from an ordinary person...
Content_86.cn: 真气乃是由内力凝聚而来，运行于人体经脉之中，\n散去一身真气的武学宗师几乎与常人无异……

Content_87.en: All Martial Arts have their uses. If results feel inefficient, check which Martial Art you are currently using...
Content_87.cn: 天下武功各有用处，若感到事倍功半，不妨看看自己正在运用的究竟是何功法……

Content_88.en: As the saying goes, "Food is the first necessity of the people". Aside from those with dietary restrictions, satisfying one's appetite has always been of utmost importance...
Content_88.cn: 俗话说“民以食为天”，除了少数有饮食禁忌的人，满足口腹之欲自古以来便是头等大事……

Content_89.en: Though it is said that physicians cannot heal themselves, those cultivated in medicine or poison arts\noften heal their own injuries, or detect toxins faster...
Content_89.cn: 虽有医者不自医之说，但修习医术、毒术之人，\n往往也能更快地治疗自己的伤势，抑或发现毒素的存在……

Content_90.en: All Qi Arts belong to one of the Five Elements. When the elements clash, power may backfire. When they generate one another, they work in harmony...
Content_90.cn: 凡内功皆有五行之属，五行冲克，则功力反噬；五行相生，则相辅相成……

Content_91.en: A person's fate may be destined, yet the Qi of the Five Elements fills the world.\nThrough the circulation of Qi Arts, one's internal strength may gradually transform into different attributes...
Content_91.cn: 人之生时，虽由天定，然而五行之气，充盈天地，\n凭借内功的周天运行，亦可使体内功力逐渐转化为不同的属性……
